title: One Piece Television Anime Canon Question Bank
adaptationBoundary: Released One Piece television-anime continuity only, using episodes 1–1085 in this bank; manga-only facts, films, non-continuity specials, and unreleased episodes are excluded. Anime-original continuity is included only when clearly identified, such as the G-8 arc.

notes: Questions listed in review_ids use otherwise unambiguous anime facts but their episode-number mapping should be spot-checked against a primary episode listing before production lock.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the village where Luffy grew up?
questions.explanation: Luffy was raised in Foosha Village in East Blue.

questions.prompt: Who originally gave Luffy the straw hat he wears?
questions.explanation: Shanks entrusted the straw hat to Luffy when Luffy promised to become a great pirate.

questions.prompt: Before joining Luffy, what job was Zoro known for in East Blue?
questions.explanation: Zoro was widely known as a pirate hunter.

questions.prompt: Which Devil Fruit power does Buggy use?
questions.explanation: Buggy ate the Bara Bara no Mi, allowing his body to split apart.

questions.prompt: What identity did Kuro use while serving Kaya's household?
questions.explanation: Kuro posed as Kaya’s butler, Klahadore.

questions.prompt: Which Straw Hat joins after the Baratie conflict?
questions.explanation: Sanji leaves the Baratie and joins Luffy’s crew at the end of the arc.

questions.prompt: What does Nami ask Luffy to do after finally breaking down?
questions.explanation: Nami asks Luffy for help, beginning the Straw Hats’ direct fight against Arlong.

questions.prompt: Which village is Nami's home?
questions.explanation: Nami was raised in Cocoyasi Village, which Arlong occupied.

questions.prompt: Which Marine captain confronts Luffy in Loguetown?
questions.explanation: Smoker, the smoke-powered Marine captain, pursues Luffy in Loguetown.

questions.prompt: What major sea route does the crew enter after leaving East Blue?
questions.explanation: The crew crosses Reverse Mountain and begins its Grand Line voyage.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the giant whale encountered at the Grand Line entrance?
questions.explanation: Laboon waits at Reverse Mountain for the Rumbar Pirates to return.

questions.prompt: Which pair of giants are locked in a century-long duel on Little Garden?
questions.explanation: Dorry and Brogy have fought one another on Little Garden for 100 years.

questions.prompt: What is Chopper's role when he first joins the Straw Hats?
questions.explanation: Chopper joins as the crew’s doctor.

questions.prompt: Who is defeated by Luffy at the climax of the Alabasta conflict?
questions.explanation: Luffy defeats Crocodile, the mastermind behind Baroque Works’ Alabasta plan.

questions.prompt: How does Vivi signal her farewell to the departing Straw Hats?
options: A coded Den Den Mushi call
A raised hand with an X mark
questions.explanation: The crew raises marked arms so Vivi can recognize their silent farewell.

questions.prompt: What principle does Blackbeard defend when he says that people's dreams never end?
options: Pirates should avoid the Grand Line
Dreams are part of the pirate age
questions.explanation: Blackbeard’s speech in Mock Town affirms that a new age of dreams is underway.

questions.prompt: What is Bellamy's defining attitude toward the old dreams of pirates?
options: He wants to report them to the Marines
questions.explanation: Bellamy mocks ideas such as Sky Island and the One Piece rather than believing in them.

questions.prompt: What name does the Skypiea arc use for the sensing ability later associated with Observation Haki?
questions.explanation: The priests and Eneru call their powerful sensing ability Mantra.

questions.prompt: Why is Luffy naturally resistant to Eneru's lightning attacks?
questions.explanation: Rubber is an insulator, so Eneru’s electricity does not affect Luffy normally.

questions.prompt: Which Marine vice admiral commands the G-8 base in the anime-original arc?
questions.explanation: Vice Admiral Jonathan is the strategic commander of the G-8 base.

questions.prompt: What contest do the Straw Hats and Foxy Pirates enter?
questions.explanation: The Davy Back Fight is a pirate contest whose prizes can include crew members.

questions.prompt: Which former admiral defeats Luffy and the Straw Hats after Long Ring Long Land?
questions.explanation: Aokiji demonstrates the overwhelming gap between an admiral and the crew at that point.

questions.prompt: What is the Franky Family's main base of operations in Water 7?
questions.explanation: The Franky Family operates from a scrapyard-style hideout in Water 7.

questions.prompt: What does Robin finally say when the Straw Hats ask what she wants?
options: I want to be Pirate King
I want to return to Ohara
questions.explanation: Robin declares that she wants to live, accepting the crew’s rescue.

questions.prompt: What triggers Chopper's uncontrolled Monster Point transformation at Enies Lobby?
options: A fourth Rumble Ball in six hours
A third Rumble Ball within a short period
questions.explanation: Using a third Rumble Ball in a short span forces Chopper into Monster Point.

questions.prompt: Which member of the Straw Hats says goodbye to the Going Merry during its funeral?
questions.explanation: Luffy leads the crew’s emotional farewell to their damaged ship.

questions.prompt: Who is Ace pursuing when the anime shows his decisive clash?
questions.explanation: Ace confronts Marshall D. Teach, also known as Blackbeard.

questions.prompt: What does Zoro agree to take from Kuma in exchange for Luffy's safety?
questions.explanation: Zoro accepts all of Luffy’s accumulated pain and exhaustion.

questions.prompt: What happens to the Straw Hats at the end of the Sabaody conflict?
options: They enter the New World together
questions.explanation: Kuma sends each crew member to a different location.

questions.prompt: Where does Kuma send Nami during the crew's separation?
questions.explanation: Nami is sent to Weatheria, a sky island of weather scholars.

questions.prompt: Why does Luffy enter Impel Down?
questions.explanation: Luffy infiltrates the prison to rescue his brother Ace before his execution.

questions.prompt: Who sacrifices his chance to escape so Luffy can reach Marineford?
questions.explanation: Bon Clay stays behind to operate the gate and gives Luffy another chance.

questions.prompt: What happens to Portgas D. Ace during the Marineford war?
questions.explanation: Ace dies after shielding Luffy from Akainu’s attack.

questions.prompt: What does Whitebeard affirm about the One Piece in his final moments?
questions.explanation: Whitebeard declares that the One Piece is real and that its discovery will shake the world.

questions.prompt: How long does the Straw Hats' planned separation last before their reunion?
questions.explanation: The crew trains separately for two years before returning to Sabaody.

questions.prompt: What kind of place is Fish-Man Island located in?
options: Under the sea beneath the Red Line
questions.explanation: Fish-Man Island lies beneath the Red Line, under the sea.

questions.prompt: What is the name of Caesar Clown's poisonous gas weapon?
questions.explanation: Shinokuni is the weaponized gas released over Punk Hazard.

questions.prompt: Who rules Dressrosa when the Straw Hats arrive?
questions.explanation: Doflamingo rules Dressrosa through his royal identity and underworld power.

questions.prompt: What identity does Sabo recover during the Dressrosa tournament storyline?
questions.explanation: Sabo’s memories of Luffy and Ace return during the Corrida Colosseum events.

questions.prompt: What initial does Law reveal is part of his full name?
questions.explanation: Law’s full name is Trafalgar D. Water Law.

questions.prompt: What message do the Mink leaders repeat when the Straw Hats ask about Raizo?
questions.explanation: The Minks repeatedly insist that Raizo is safe on Zou.

questions.prompt: What unusual feature does Charlotte Pudding hide beneath her bangs?
questions.explanation: Pudding is a Three-Eye Tribe member with a third eye.

questions.prompt: Which fighting style does Katakuri combine with his Mochi Mochi no Mi?
questions.explanation: Katakuri uses the trident Mogura with his mochi powers.

questions.prompt: Why does Sanji initially leave the Straw Hats in the Whole Cake Island saga?
options: He is recruited by the Marines
He is coerced into a political marriage
He wants to become a Yonko
questions.explanation: The Vinsmokes and Big Mom Pirates force Sanji into the arranged marriage plot.

questions.prompt: What is the main food Sanji prepares as the Whole Cake Island escape reaches its crisis?
questions.explanation: Sanji and the cooks complete the wedding cake that calms Big Mom.

source.episodeTitle: A Captivating Flavor! Sanji's Cake of Happiness!
source.title: 第875話 魅惑の味 幸せのサンジのケーキ | TVアニメ

questions.prompt: What alias does Luffy use when entering Wano Country?
questions.explanation: Luffy takes the Wano name Luffytaro while undercover.

questions.prompt: Which legendary pirate crew is identified as having once united Kaido, Big Mom, and Whitebeard?
questions.explanation: The Rocks Pirates are the former crew that included those future Emperors.

questions.prompt: Whose ship does Kozuki Oden first join after leaving Wano?
questions.explanation: Oden first sails with Whitebeard before later joining Roger.

questions.prompt: How is Oden executed by Kaido in the anime?
options: He is thrown into the sea
questions.explanation: Oden endures the boiling execution while holding up his retainers.

questions.prompt: Who are the first five fighters shown confronting Kaido on the rooftop of Onigashima?
options: Luffy, Zoro, Law, Kid, and Killer
Luffy, Sanji, Jinbe, Marco, and Yamato
Zoro, Robin, Franky, Brook, and Nami
Law, Drake, Hawkins, Apoo, and Killer
questions.explanation: The rooftop supernova group is Luffy, Zoro, Law, Kid, and Killer.

questions.prompt: What advanced application of Haki does Luffy begin using against Kaido?
questions.explanation: Luffy learns to coat attacks in Conqueror’s Haki.

questions.prompt: What is the name of King’s revealed Lunarian flame-based power?
options: His flame remains active behind him
questions.explanation: King’s Lunarian physiology includes a flame burning on his back.

questions.prompt: What transformation does Luffy reveal in the episode titled around the peak of his power?
questions.explanation: Luffy awakens the power later identified with Gear 5.

questions.prompt: What recurring sound is tied to Luffy's awakened heartbeat?
questions.explanation: The awakened heartbeat is described as the Drums of Liberation.

questions.prompt: Who is defeated when Luffy's Bajrang Gun finishes the rooftop battle?
questions.explanation: Luffy’s Bajrang Gun overcomes Kaido.

questions.prompt: Which two members of the Worst Generation defeat Big Mom in Wano?
questions.explanation: Trafalgar Law and Eustass Kid combine attacks to defeat Big Mom.

questions.prompt: What is Yamato's Devil Fruit transformation?
questions.explanation: Yamato ate the Inu Inu no Mi, Model: Okuchi-no-Makami.

questions.prompt: Which former Whitebeard Pirates commander arrives in Wano to protect the alliance?
questions.explanation: Marco arrives and supports the alliance during the Onigashima battle.

source.episodeTitle: Reinforcements Arrive! The Commander of the Whitebeard Pirates!
source.title: E988 - Reinforcements Arrive! The Commander of the Whitebeard Pirates!

questions.prompt: What is the name of the Mink transformation used under the full moon?
questions.explanation: Sulong is the Minks’ moon-triggered transformation.

questions.prompt: Which trio of allies remains in Wano after the Straw Hats depart?
questions.explanation: Yamato, Momonosuke, and Kin’emon remain in Wano after the Straw Hats sail onward.

source.episodeTitle: The Last Curtain! Luffy and Momonosuke's Vow
source.title: E1085 - The Last Curtain! Luffy and Momonosuke's Vow

questions.prompt: What is distinctive about Nami's tattoo after she joins Arlong's side?
options: It combines a tangerine and pinwheel motif
It shows the World Government crest
It is a skull with three swords
questions.explanation: Nami’s tattoo combines Bellemere’s tangerine symbol with Genzo’s pinwheel.

questions.prompt: Why do Dorry and Brogy continue their duel despite no longer remembering its original cause?
options: Their warrior code demands they honor the duel
The Marines command them to fight
A Devil Fruit forces them to continue
They are competing for the One Piece
questions.explanation: The giants continue because their pride and warrior honor bind them to the contest.

questions.prompt: What do the Straw Hats use to show Vivi that they still consider her a friend?
questions.explanation: The hidden X marks let Vivi recognize the crew without a public farewell.

questions.prompt: Which complete name does Robin state when she declares that she wants to live?
questions.explanation: Robin identifies herself as Nico Robin while making her plea.

questions.prompt: What is the name associated with Blackbeard's ship in official One Piece reference material?
questions.explanation: The ship is identified as the Saber of Xebec in official reference material. The anime shows Blackbeard's ship, but the episode appearance does not itself establish the ship's name.

questions.prompt: What does Sanji find after Zoro returns from Kuma's bargain?
options: Blood on the ground and no trace of Luffy’s pain
questions.explanation: The crew sees the aftermath while Zoro conceals the pain he took from Luffy.

questions.prompt: What change in the world does Whitebeard's final declaration promise?
options: The One Piece will be found and the era will erupt
The Red Line will split that day
questions.explanation: Whitebeard’s final words signal that the great pirate age will continue.

questions.prompt: Which destination receives Usopp after Kuma scatters the crew?
questions.explanation: Usopp is sent to the Boin Archipelago, where he trains with Heracles.

questions.prompt: Which destination receives Zoro after Kuma scatters the crew?
questions.explanation: Zoro is sent to Kuraigana Island, where Mihawk is staying.

questions.prompt: What happens to the giant children Caesar experiments on if they miss their candy dose?
questions.explanation: The addictive candy is used to keep the abducted children compliant.

questions.prompt: What does the 'D.' in Trafalgar D. Water Law's name indicate in the anime's revealed identity?
options: A family initial tied to the D. clan
questions.explanation: The initial marks Law as one of the people carrying the mysterious D. name.

questions.prompt: Why had the Minks refused to betray Raizo despite Jack's torture?
options: He was their protected guest from Wano
questions.explanation: Raizo was sheltered by the Minks, who would not surrender their guest.

questions.prompt: Which battle cry is associated with the mysterious inherited power that begins to stir in Luffy?
questions.explanation: The drums are the auditory sign of the awakening associated with liberation.

questions.prompt: Which Devil Fruit name does the Five Elders say was concealed by the World Government?
options: Hito Hito no Mi, Model: Nika
Uo Uo no Mi, Model: Seiryu
questions.explanation: The Elders identify the fruit’s true name as the Hito Hito no Mi, Model: Nika.

questions.explanation: Kaido recognizes the awakened Luffy as the figure he believes may be Joy Boy.
